messages:
pagerbot: ALERT fired PD-34288 — prod-usw2: 5xx rate spike above threshold (4% over 5m). Signal: http_errors_rate. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-34288

oncall-tim: acked PD-34288 :white_check_mark: grabbing pager.

sre-jen: i'm on it. first glance: 502/504 mix, small number of 500s. not global yet but concentrated on inference-gateway pods in usw2-a.

maria: customer impact? any active incidents reported to support?

support-ops: support-ops here — a single customer report for streaming timeouts, but nothing widespread in the ticketing system yet. I'll flag if it ramps.

sre-jen: running quick prometheus check: `expr: (sum(rate(http_errors_total{env="prod",region="usw2"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod",region="usw2"}[1m]))) * 100` → ~4.8% over last 5m, up from baseline 0.4%.

api-team: rolling deploy to inference-gateway started 18m ago — could be related. which revision?

sre-jen: good call. showing recent deploy tag `gateway:v2026.03.2` around 00:17 UTC. checking pod logs for 502 traces.

pagerbot: pager-related note: runbook 'gateway-5xx-spike' recommended mitigations: 1) revert recent deploy 2) scale gateway 3) traffic-shift region fallback.

oncall-tim: please avoid immediate revert unless we see clear error path. try scale + cache-warmup first. if error rate keeps rising past 6% we'll rollback.

sre-jen: scaling inference-gateway from 8 -> 16 pods in usw2 now: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=16`

sre-jen: also enabling soft-fallback routing for the next 10m for critical routes: toggling routing weight for prod-usw2 -> prod-usw1 (10% fallback) via router-admin.

maria: enabling fallback — notifying SRE. support-ops: can you message the affected customers: say we're investigating and have mitigations in flight?

support-ops: sending a short note to impacted customer contact list now.

sre-jen: logs: seeing repeated upstream connection reset to model-sidecar for a subset of requests. sample trace id: trace-9f2c. pushing more verbose logs.

oncall-tim: good. keep me posted every 5m. if scale + fallback doesn't bring 5xx under 2% by 00:40 UTC, we'll trigger rollback.

(00:34 UTC) sre-jen: 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% after scaling + 10% fallback. still watching.

support-ops: customer notice updated — saying transient errors mitigated, continue to monitor.

(00:41 UTC) oncall-tim: keeping PD open. handoff in 25m to night oncall if stable. leaving note: mitigation = scale + partial traffic shift; no rollback required at this time.

(00:49 UTC) sre-jen: leaving postmortem stub in #incidents-retros with initial timeline + logs. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gateway-5xx-spike.

maria: thanks team — will follow up on customer outreach. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD-34288 set to status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

---
notes: brief, incremental mitigation avoided rollback; next steps: root-cause triage (deploy vs upstream model-sidecar), add guardrails to prevent similar faulty deploy from routing full traffic, adjust alert thresholds to include correlated model-sidecar errors.
